name: Snatched jawline look

lead: A snatched jawline is slang for a sharp, well-defined edge along the lower face, where the jaw reads clearly against the neck. It is a look rather than a single method.

The jawline is made of the mandible and the chewing muscles around it, so appearance depends on bone structure, body fat and muscle. Lower body fat, grooming and styling are the common ways people try to bring it out.

paras: People pursue it through fat loss, chewing habits, haircuts and facial hair that frame the jaw, and posture that avoids a collapsed neck. Cosmetic procedures are also discussed for the area.
Excessive chewing and clenching can enlarge the masseter and strain the jaw joint. Procedures carry their own risks.

angle.text: The look comes from the underlying bone, the masseter muscle and the amount of fat over them, which people adjust through leanness, chewing and styling.

lead: The snatched jawline look is slang for a sharp, defined jaw. It involves the mandible, which joins the skull at the temporomandibular joints and includes the chin and the angle of the jaw [1].

Muscle contributes to the shape. The masseter closes the jaw, and habitual clenching, grinding or constant gum chewing can enlarge it, which changes lower-face contour and can cause asymmetry if the muscles grow unequally [2].
infobox: Mandible, chin, angle of the jaw, masseter

paras: The lower jaw includes the mandibular symphysis, the mental protuberance and the angle of the mandible below the ramus [1]. The masseter is a muscle of mastication that raises the lower jaw, and chewing or clenching habits can enlarge it, sometimes prompting people to seek care over comments about facial appearance [2].
